notes.title: Thanks to all purchasers!
notes.notes:
Hi, hope you are having some fun with this game, it's part of my vision of what a free roam sandbox Superhero game could be, with the freedom to play your own Superhero or Simulate a Hero from the Comicbooks. 

Oh and don't forget to use your Secret Identity, [the mask and hat button top right] it can help you check out an encounter before you attempt to fight. You shouldn't get instant aggro when you hide behind your disguise.
